script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

Thirtysomething JASON, sporting a five o'clock shadow, sits across from a YOUTHFUL COACH JESSICA. They exchange small talk, Jason sipping coffee, and Jessica looking intently at him.

JASON
(Nervously)
So, why did you invite me here, Coach Jessica?

JESSICA
(Smiling)
I've been watching your career for quite some time, Jason. I believe you've reached the pinnacle of basketball. But now it's time for a change.

Jason looks surprised, a hint of anger in his eyes.

JASON
(Angrily)
You think I can't do it anymore? That I'm washed up?

Jessica leans in, her expression serious.

JESSICA
(Gently)
No, not at all. It's just that basketball may not be the best fit for you anymore.

Jason takes a deep breath, trying to calm down.

JASON
What do you suggest?

Jessica pulls out a brochure.

JESSICA
Soccer. You've always had a knack for it.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - LATER

Jason stands in front of his mirror, looking at his reflection. He used to be a dominant basketball player, now he's just an average joe. He sighs and starts to pack his bags.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - DAY

Jason arrives at the soccer field, sweaty and nervous. He's greeted by a group of PLAYERS, all younger than him.

PLAYER 1
(Teasingly)
Hey, new guy, you better be good. We don't have room for slackers.

Jason smiles, determined to prove himself.

INT. SOCCER TRAINING - DAY

Jason trains with the team, pushing himself harder than ever before. He's out of his comfort zone, but he's determined to make the transition.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason sits on the couch, exhausted from training. He looks at an old basketball trophy on the shelf, a reminder of his past. He takes a deep breath and stands up, determined to forge a new path.

INT. SOCCER GAME - DAY

Jason plays his first game with the team, nerves jangling in his stomach. The game is tough, but he plays with determination and passion. His teammates begin to see his potential.

INT. COACH JESSICA'S OFFICE - DAY

Jason meets with Coach Jessica after the game. She congratulates him on a solid performance.

JESSICA
You have a natural talent for soccer, Jason. But it's up to you to work hard and prove yourself.

Jason nods, determined.

JASON
I won't let you down, Coach.

INT. SOCCER TRAINING - DAY

Jason continues to train with the team, pushing himself to be better every day. He's no longer just a basketball player - he's a soccer player, and he's determined to make a name for himself.

INT. SOCCER GAME - DAY

Jason plays in another game, this time against a rival team. The pressure is on, but he rises to the occasion, scoring the winning goal in the final minutes of the game.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - EVENING

Jason sits across from Coach Jessica, a smile on his face. He's come a long way since their first meeting.

JASON
(Gratefully)
Thank you, Coach Jessica. I couldn't have done it without your support.

Jessica smiles, proud of her student.

JESSICA
You're welcome, Jason. But remember, the real credit goes to you.

FADE OUT.
